授業概要
この講義は、再生可能エネルギー、特にソーラーエネルギーに興味を持つ科学分野の修士課程の学生を対象としています。本講演では、太陽光発電・太陽熱エネルギー技術の原理と応用について簡単に紹介する。それは、幅広い範囲の太陽エネルギー技術の基本要素で構成されております。この科目を履修により、学生はソーラーエネルギー分野でさらに深く研究を行うことができます。
This lecture is aimed at master course students in scientific discipline who are interested in renewable energies, in particular, solar energy. This lecture briefly introduces the principle and applications of photovoltaic and solar thermal technologies. It is composed of fundamental elements of solar energy technology in a wide scope, which enables the students to perform a further and deeper study in this field.

全体の教育目標
Through this lecture, students should understand the background, the progress and the trends of solar energy technology. Specifically, a student should grasp basic principles of photovoltaic and solar thermal conservation, which requires the understanding of fundamental semiconductor physics and light management technologies. Furthermore, a student should grasp basic principles of solar cells with various structures and materials, as well as solar cell evaluation techniques. An overview of photovoltaic system also needs to be understood. In addition, as the core component of a solar thermal energy system, solar collector related technology has to be grasped. A student also has to get to know the applications of photovoltaic and solar thermal technologies. The students are not expected to study in a deep-going way on any specific topic of this lecture but to understand the solar energy technology in a wide scope, which enables the students to perform a further and deeper study in this field.
個別の教育目標
Sufficient exercise and communication through exchange of ideas in class must be done to understand the fundamental principle and technology of solar energy.
